purpose: Record current external-source access and license facts used by the whole-game resource gap audit. This is discovery/provenance data only.

sources.verified_fact: All Poly Haven HDRIs, textures and 3D models are CC0; commercial use and redistribution are permitted. Website terms still prohibit unauthorized scraping/data mining.
sources.automation_note: Use documented APIs/endpoints; do not scrape.

sources.verified_fact: Adobe states Mixamo characters and animations may be used royalty-free in personal, commercial and non-profit projects including video games. Adobe ID required; library/auto-rigger are bipedal humanoid only.
sources.automation_note: No credential bypass; acquire manually/authenticated and export FBX.

sources.verified_fact: 2026 bundle advertises 7.47GB+ / 347+ files, royalty-free and commercially usable, with no attribution required; licensed for media production including games.
sources.automation_note: Acquire bundle manually or via provider-supported links; preserve the license version applicable on acquisition date.

sources.verified_fact: ActionVFX states free and paid assets include perpetual royalty-free commercial licenses and may be used in video games; their FAQ explicitly calls out particle flipbooks and VFX textures for Unreal/Unity.
sources.automation_note: Manual/per-product acquisition; preprocess into lightweight UE4.27-compatible assets.

sources.verified_fact: Items explicitly marked CC0 are open access; 3D may be available as glTF/glb/OBJ and data via API/GitHub.
sources.automation_note: Only CC0-marked records; OBJ remains static/reference only for this project.

sources.verified_fact: Hosted data are generally free for non-commercial and commercial use, but individual datasets can carry licenses such as CC BY 4.0. Some services/API calls require an account/API key and have rate/commercial-integration limits.
sources.automation_note: Respect dataset licenses, attribution and API-key limits; terrain data informs authored geography and never defines canon geography.

sources.verified_fact: Project Warehouse #308 reached official pack pages but staged zero files and four unresolved packs in the targeted hero batch.
production_use: world kits where manually acquired and QC-passed
sources.automation_note: Do not classify page reachability as staged payload; no fabricated/undocumented archive URLs.

prohibited_shortcuts: No scraping when site terms prohibit it.
No fan/IP replica imports without clear rights.
No source discovery result is READY_FOR_IMPORT.
No OBJ as final animated-character evidence.
evidence_boundary: External-source verification only; no asset acquisition, import, runtime integration, PIE/device/visual/performance acceptance.
